title: chelonopsis odontochila subsp. bracteata
intro: Chelonopsis odontochila subsp. bracteata, commonly known as Chinese bugleweed, is a plant species in the family Gesneriaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and fever, due to its health benefits of reducing stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Chinese bugleweed include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use as a treatment for nervous system disorders and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chinese bugleweed include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
